title: COMMAND YOUR 2026 BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES..
text: If this message blesses you, please share it with someone. There are people in your circle, in your family, in your workplace who need to hear this word. The Lord has given us a mandate for this season and we must be faithful stewards of what he releases through his vessels. Share this prayer. Share this word because destinies are hanging in the balance and the Holy Spirit wants to use you as a distribution center for this prophetic instruction. I want you to understand something tonight. We are standing at a threshold. 2026 is not just another year on the calendar. It is a prophetic window. It is a strategic season. It is a moment pregnant with divine possibilities. But I need you to hear me very clearly. Every prophetic window that God opens for advancement, the kingdom of darkness [music] also recognizes it. The enemy is not sleeping. Satan is not on holiday. The Bible says in 1 Peter 5:8, "Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh [music] about seeking whom he may devour." The word seeking means he's strategizing, he's calculating, he's planning. And if you do not take authority over the times and seasons that God has given you, the enemy will program them against you. This is why we must command 2026 before the enemy does. You cannot afford to be passive. You cannot afford to be prayerless. You cannot afford to enter into a new season [music] without prophetic instructions and militant intercession. Now, I want to take you to the scriptures because everything we do must be rooted in the word of God. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3:1, to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. God operates in seasons. There are dispensations, there are times, there are moments that carry specific grace. And when you understand the season you are in, you can access the grace that is available for that season. But when you are ignorant of the times, you will labor without results. You will struggle without breakthrough. You will work hard but remain stagnant. Listen to me. The enemy understands timing. Satan is a master strategist. He knows that if he can pollute the beginning of your year, he can contaminate the rest of it. If he can establish altars at the gate of your new season, he can monitor and manipulate your progress. This is why we must not wait until problems manifest before we pray. [music] We must be proactive. We must be aggressive. We must take our position in the spirit realm and decree the counsel of God over our lives, our families, our businesses, our ministries, our nations. The Bible says in Isaiah 45 to 111, "Thus sayaeth the Lord, the Holy One of Israel and his maker, ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands, command ye me." Did you see that? Command ye me. God is giving you permission to command. Not to beg, not to hope, not to wish, but to command. When you understand your identity in Christ, when you understand your position as a son, when you understand the authority that has been delegated to you, you will stop begging and you will start decreeing. But you cannot decree what you do not know. This is why you need prophetic intelligence. You need to know what God is saying about your life. You need to know the plans of the enemy against your destiny. You need to know the open doors that [music] heaven has prepared for you. And this knowledge comes through intimacy with the Holy Spirit. It comes through prayer. It comes through meditation on the word. It comes through sensitivity to the prophetic voice. Now, as we prepare to engage this season prophetically, I want you to understand the weapons of our warfare. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 10:4, "For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds." The battles you will face in 2026 are not physical battles. They are spiritual battles. The limitations you have experienced are not natural limitations. They are spiritual limitations. And spiritual problems require spiritual solutions. Some of you have been fighting in the wrong realm. You have been using your intellect, your connections, [music] your strategies, your plans, but you have neglected the place of prayer. You have neglected the place of fasting. You have neglected the place of spiritual warfare. And this is why you keep going in circles. This is why you keep experiencing the same frustrations year after year. But tonight, we are going to break that cycle. We are going to uproot every foundation of stagnation. We are going to dismantle every altar of delay. I prophesy to someone here tonight. Every cycle of frustration is broken in the name of Jesus. Every pattern of almost there but not quite is shattered by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every demonic reinforcement against your progress is destroyed by fire. I see the angel of the Lord going before you, removing every obstacle, clearing every path, opening every door that has been shut against you. Now, let me show you something powerful in the scriptures. In the book of Esther chapter 4, when Modcai sent a message to Queen Esther about the decree that had been issued to destroy the Jews, he said something very profound. He said, "Who knoweth whether thou had come to the kingdom for such a time as this? Your presence in 2026 is not accidental. You are alive at this time for a reason. God has preserved you, protected you, and positioned you for this season. But you must recognize the assignment and fulfill it. The reason why the enemy fights you so much is because he knows what God has invested in you. He knows the potential you carry. He knows the calling on your life. He knows that if you ever step into your full identity and operate in your full authority, you will destroy his plans and establish the kingdom of God in your sphere [music] of influence. This is why he attacks your mind, your health, your finances, your relationships because he's trying to keep you distracted, discouraged, and defeated. But I have good news for you tonight. The Bible says in Romans 8:37, "Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us." You are not a victim. You are a victor. You are not defeated. You are destined for dominion. And in this season, every agenda of the enemy against your life is canceled by the blood of Jesus. Father, we thank you for your word. We thank you for the revelation of our identity in Christ. We thank you for the authority you have given us. And now Lord, as we prepare to command this season, we ask for the Holy Spirit to take charge, let your power be released. Let your presence be manifested. Let your purposes be established in Jesus's mighty name. Now, I want you to pray with me. This is not a time to be passive. This is not a time to be sleepy. This is a warfare prayer session. The Bible [music] says, "The violent take it by force." You must engage your spirit. You must engage your faith. You must engage your authority. Lift up your voice and pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, I take authority over 2026. I command this year to align with the purposes of God for my life. Every agenda of the enemy for this season, I have bought it by fire. Every plantation of darkness assigned to my year, I uproot it by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every evil decree, every evil pronouncement, every evil prophesy spoken against my life and destiny, I nullify it by the blood of Jesus. Every satanic calendar programmed against me, catch fire now. Every demonic timetable assigned to monitor my movements be destroyed by fire. Every witchcraft manipulation of my times and seasons be dismantled in the name of Jesus. I refuse to cooperate with the agenda of darkness. I refuse to fulfill evil predictions. I refuse to dance to the tune of household [music] wickedness. Father, I decree that 2026 is my year of supernatural open doors. It is my year of divine connections. It is my year of unprecedented favor. It is my year of overflowing abundance. It is my year of fulfilled prophecies. It is my year of answered prayers. It is my year of manifestation. Everything that you have promised me, Lord, let it come to pass in this season, I decree that every closed door is opening, every delayed blessing is being released. Every blocked opportunity is being unblocked. Every satanic embargo against my progress is lifted. Every spiritual cage holding my virtues is broken. Every evil altar monitoring my destiny is destroyed. I am free to fulfill my God- orained assignment. I am free to walk in divine alignment. I am free to experience the fullness of what God has prepared for me. Now, I want to prophesy over your finances. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which he swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day." God wants to bless you financially, but you must understand that the blessing of God goes beyond [music] money. It is the power to create wealth. It is divine ideas. It is strategic connections. It is supernatural opportunities in this season. I decree that the spirit of poverty is broken over your life. The spirit of lack is destroyed. The spirit of financial stagnation is dismantled. You will no longer struggle. You will no longer beg. You will no longer bear the mercy of economic systems. God is releasing to you the power to create wealth. He's giving you divine strategies. He's connecting you with the right people. He's opening doors that no man can shut. Pray this with me. Father, I receive the power to create wealth. I refuse to be broke in 2026. I refuse to be limited by economic challenges. I decree that divine ideas are flowing into my mind. Divine strategies are being downloaded into my spirit. Divine connections are being orchestrated by the Holy Spirit. I am walking into a season of financial overflow. My bands are filled with plenty. My vats are overflowing with new wine. Everywhere I go, doors of opportunity are opening. Everything I touch is prospering. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. Let me tell you something. Some of you have been praying for breakthrough for years and you have not seen results because you are praying against the wrong thing. You are praying against symptoms instead of dealing with root causes. You are praying against manifestations instead of destroying foundations. The Bible says in Jeremiah 1:10, "See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms to root out and to pull down and to destroy and to throw down, to build and to plant. Before you can build, you must destroy. Before you can plant, you must uproot. [music] There are some things that God wants to do in your life, but there are evil foundations that must first be demolished. There are some covenants that must be broken. There are some causes that must be reversed. There are some evil verdicts that must be overturned. And this is the season for it. I want you to pray aggressively now. This is not time for religious prayers. This is time for militant intercession. Pray every evil foundation in my life be destroyed by fire. Every foundational covenant working against me be broken by the blood of Jesus. Every evil dedication, every evil initiation, [music] every evil covenant between me and the kingdom of darkness, I renounce it and I break it by the power in [music] the name of Jesus. Every ancestral curse be broken. Every generational bondage be shattered. Every family pattern of failure, I disconnect from it. Every evil inheritance, I reject it. I am a new creation in Christ Jesus. Old things have passed away. All things have become new. My past does not control my future. My family history does not determine my destiny. I am walking in the newness that God has prepared for me. Now, I want to speak to those of you who are believing God for marriage in this season. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:22, "Who so findeth a wife findeth a good thing and obtainth favor of the Lord." Marriage is a blessing. It is a divine institution. And God wants you to be rightly connected. But the enemy also understands the power of connection and he will try to manipulate you into wrong relationships that will derail your destiny. This is why you must pray. You must ask God for divine guidance. You must be sensitive to the leading of the Holy Spirit. Some of you have been in relationships that are draining you spiritually. Relationships that are making you compromise your values. Relationships that are taking you away from your purpose. And God is saying it is time to let go. It is better to be single and in the will of God than to be married and out of alignment with your destiny. Pray this. Father, I commit my marital destiny into your hands. Every wrong connection, I disconnect from it now. Every relationship that is not ordained by you, I release it. Every manipulation of the enemy to connect me with the wrong person, I reject it by fire. Lord, I am asking you to bring forth my God ordained spouse. Let there be a divine orchestration. Let there be a supernatural connection. I will not settle for less than your best. I will not compromise my standards. I will not be pressured by age or by societal expectations. I am waiting on you and I know that you will not fail me. For those of you who are already married, I want you to pray for your marriage. The enemy is attacking marriages with unprecedented fury in this season. Divorce rates are rising. Homes are being destroyed. But your marriage will not be a casualty. Your home will not be a statistic. You are going to experience a supernatural turnaround. Pray. Father, I cover my marriage with the blood of Jesus. Every attack against my home be destroyed by fire. Every spirit of misunderstanding, I bind you and I cast you out. Every spirit of strife, every spirit of offense, every spirit of unforgiveness, I command you to leave my home now. Lord, release a fresh anointing of love. Release a fresh anointing of unity. release a fresh anointing of understanding. Let there be peace in my home. Let there be joy in my marriage. Let there be divine alignment between me and my spouse. Now, I want to address those of you who are dealing with health challenges. The Bible says in Exodus 15:26, "For I am the Lord that health thee." God is Jehovah Rafa. He is the Lord your healer, and healing is part of your covenant benefits. Jesus bore your sicknesses and carried your diseases on the cross. You do not have to live with pain. You do not have to accept that diagnosis as final. God has the final say. Listen to me. Some of you have been battling sickness for years and you have been to different hospitals. [music] You have consulted different doctors but you have not received your healing because you have not dealt with the spiritual root. Not all sickness is natural. Some sicknesses are spiritual attacks. Some sicknesses are curses. Some sicknesses are demonic afflictions and they require spiritual warfare. Pray with me now. Every sickness in my body, come out by fire. Every disease, every affliction, every pain, I command you to leave my body now in the name of Jesus. Every evil arrow lodged in my body, come out and go back to your sender. Every poison in my system be neutralized by the blood of Jesus. Every demonic plantation in my organs be uprooted by fire. Father, I receive my healing. I receive divine health. I receive strength. I receive vitality. From the crown of my head to the sole of my feet, I am healed. My organs are functioning properly. My blood is [music] flowing properly. My bones are strong. My immune system is fortified. I am whole. I am healthy. I am strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. Some of you need to pray for your children. The Bible says in Isaiah 54-13, "And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children." Your children are a heritage from the Lord. They are your arrows, and the enemy wants to destroy them before they fulfill their destiny. But you must stand in the gap. You must cover them with prayer. You [music] must decree the purposes of God over their lives. Pray. Father, I bring my children before you. I cover them with the blood of Jesus. Every evil eye monitoring my children be blinded by fire. Every evil hand stretched out against my children be paralyzed. Every evil plan, every evil manipulation, every evil initiation, I destroy it by the power of [music] the Holy Ghost. My children will not be victims of drug addiction. My children will not be victims of sexual immorality. My children will not be casualties of wrong associations. They are covered. They are protected. They are preserved for greatness. I decree that my children are taught of the Lord. They are walking in wisdom. They are walking in understanding. They are walking in the fear of God. They are fulfilling their God orained assignments. They are making impact in their generation. They are blazing the trail in their fields. They are bringing glory to God. Every good thing I have prayed for them shall come to pass. Now let me speak to your career and your business. The Bible says in Psalm 1:3 describing the blessed man, "And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water that bringeth forth his fruit in his season. His leaf also shall not wither and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. This is your portion. Whatever you do shall prosper. [music] Not some things, not a few things, but whatsoever. But prosperity is not automatic. It is connected to your obedience. It is connected to your faithfulness. It is connected to your alignment with God's principles. The Bible says in 3 John 1:2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health. Even as thy soul prosperth, your external prosperity is tied to your internal prosperity. If your soul is not prospering, your business will not prosper. If your soul is not prospering, your career will not prosper." This is why you must invest in your spiritual growth. You must invest in studying the word. You must invest in prayer. You must invest in fellowship with other believers. You must invest in serving in the house of God. These are not optional. They are requirements for sustained success. Pray. Father, I commit my career into your hands. I commit my business into your hands. Every satanic attack against my place of work be destroyed by fire. Every evil monitoring spirit be bound and cast out. Every spirit of demotion, I reject you. Every spirit of stagnation I cast you out. Every conspiracy against my promotion be scattered. Lord, I am asking for divine favor. Cause me to find favor with those in authority. Cause me to be recognized. Cause me to [music] be celebrated. Cause me to be promoted. Open doors of opportunity that no man can shut. Release divine ideas that will set me apart. Release divine strategies that will bring breakthrough. Let there be an unprecedented increase in my finances. Let there be overflow in every area of my life. I want to prophesy to someone. You have been faithful in the place of obscurity. You have been [music] faithful when no one was watching. You have been faithful when you were not appreciated. You have been faithful when you were misunderstood. But God has been watching. God has been recording. God has been preparing you. And this is your season of emergence. This is your season of being brought forth. This is your season of recognition. Get ready. The spotlight is coming to you. The promotion is coming to you. The elevation is coming to you. It [music] is your time. Now, as we close this time of prayer and prophetic declaration, I want you to understand that what we have done tonight is just the beginning. Prayer is not a one-time event. It is a lifestyle. You must maintain your spiritual altar. You must maintain your prayer life. You must maintain [music] your consecration. The Bible says in 1 Thessalonians 5:17, "Pray without ceasing." The reason why many people lose their breakthroughs is because they stop praying after the breakthrough comes. They become complacent. They become careless. They become prayerless. And the enemy comes in and steals what God has given [music] them. But you will not be a victim. You will guard your blessing with prayer. You will protect your family with prayer. You will secure your future with prayer. I am decreeing over your life right now that you are entering into a season of divine protection. Psalm 91 is activated over you. No evil shall befall you. No plague shall come near your dwelling. The angels of the Lord are encamped around you. The fire of God is surrounding you. You are untouchable. You are unreachable. You are unstoppable. Every weapon formed against you shall not prosper. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. Every scheme of the enemy is frustrated. [music] Every plan of darkness is aborted. You are walking in the divine immunity that comes from dwelling in the secret place of the most high. I see you walking through doors that have been closed for years. I see you receiving phone calls that will change your story. I see you encountering divine helpers who will position [music] you for greatness. I see you experiencing favor that cannot be explained. I see you receiving [music] testimonies that will make you a reference point. This is your season. This is your time. This is your moment. Receive it by faith. Embrace it with expectation. Walk in it with confidence. And as you go forth from [music] this place, remember that you are not alone. The Lord is with you. The Holy Spirit is in you. The angels of God are assigned to you. You are a career of the presence of God. You are a vessel of honor. You are a child of destiny. Go forth and command this season before the enemy does. Take [music] your position in the realm of the spirit. Decree the counsel of God. Release the prophetic word and watch as heaven responds to your prayers and brings to pass everything that God has spoken concerning you. In the mighty name of Jesus, I seal every word that has been released tonight. I seal every prayer that has been [music] prayed. I seal every decree that has been made. Let it be established in the spirit realm. Let it be manifested in the physical realm. Let the will of God be done in your life as it is in heaven. You are blessed. You are favored. You are covered. You are victorious. Now go and possess your possession. Go and take your inheritance. Go and walk in the fullness of what God has prepared for you. This is your season of commanding the year before the enemy does.
